WITH periods AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, p.fiscal_year, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_net, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS trading_days
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN periods p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, p.fiscal_year, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN periods p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
store_net AS (
  SELECT a.store_id, a.fiscal_year, a.trading_days, a.gross_net - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales a LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.store_id = a.store_id AND r.fiscal_year = a.fiscal_year
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM store_net GROUP BY 1
  HAVING count(*) = 2 AND min(trading_days) = 28
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  round(100 * (sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) / sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct,
  count(DISTINCT store_id) AS n_stores,
  sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) AS ty, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) AS ly
FROM store_net WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
